'''EasterlingMaster Tatooine Aliens''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[EasterlingMaster]]
* '''Published:''' 24 February 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Jabba's Palace|JP-D-tatooinejabbaspalace.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Twi'lek Advisor|JP-D-twilekadvisor.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Tatooine: Jabba's Palace
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTat TatJP EasterlingMaster DS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This will be my first SWCCG deck, so. Tips would be very helpful. Thanks.

== Notes ==

* Starting interrupt Twi'lek Advisor with Expand The Empire and three Jabba's Palace sites; no Objective.
* TIE Scout is posted on two separate lines under Space; combined as 2x.
* Posted 'Resistance' (under Effects) dested the Jabba's Palace Effect, not the Reflections III shield; 'J’Quile' J'Quille.

== Strategy ==

I really don't know. I only bought one booster box of RI, and hopefully I'll be getting more cards soon. But, for strategy I guess kinda' like Goblin Swarms in LOTR. I haven't played a game yet, but I'll be having some friends over this weekend to test it out. Mos Eisley for Tonnika Sisters, and Swilla Corey to get another Thief. I want to get some more Jawas, that would help. But, thats basicly it, try to pump up some Aliens, too. Thanks agian!
